Project management

Project Risk Radar

I built a launch forecast that shows how one supplier update affects the schedule, with the source sentence and the tasks that move.

Independent project

The problem

A supplier can move a delivery date in a short message. The project manager still has to check which tasks depend on that delivery and whether the launch can stay on schedule.

The decision

I separated reading the message from doing the schedule math. The app shows the date it found and uses task dependencies to calculate the impact. It asks for review when the message is unclear.

What you can try

Analyze the fictional supplier message and see the launch move from March 12 to March 16. Then try the shorter delay and see how the schedule absorbs it. You can also load a project CSV and set your own workweek.
